title: Why Your First $1,000 Is So Hard to Save

scenes.voice: Your first thousand is tough. Here's why.
scenes.headline: WHY IS THE FIRST $1,000 SO HARD?

scenes.voice: Payday hits. Your bank balance finally looks good.
scenes.headline: PAYDAY HITS 💸

scenes.voice: Then rent, food, subscriptions, and bills take their share.
scenes.headline: THEN… THE BILLS ARRIVE

scenes.voice: One car repair or dentist visit can wipe out your savings.
scenes.headline: SURPRISE EXPENSE: $240

scenes.voice: Try this: automatically save ten or twenty dollars each payday. Start small, and repeat.
scenes.headline: AUTOMATE A SMALL AMOUNT

scenes.voice: Your first thousand grows one payday at a time. Follow The Money Stickman for simple money lessons.
scenes.headline: ONE PAYDAY AT A TIME.

notes: Illustrative example only. No guaranteed results. Do not imply that $1,000 is equally attainable for everyone; encourage viewers to adapt savings to their circumstances.
